digest.component_or_area: route reconciler differ/apply core via dependency injection
propositions: Reconciler core differ/apply modules currently import vendor mapper entrypoints (_map_local_to_jira_fields / _map_jira_to_local_fields) directly instead of via Backend-port dependency injection.
outbound_differ, inbound_differ, and apply_inbound must receive injected mapper instances from the Backend port rather than direct module-level imports.
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK must be single-sourced in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py and imported from there rather than defined inline.
Injected mappers must be actively used by each differ and reconciliation phase, not bypassed or ignored.
Backend-neutral core should not reach vendor-specific mapper implementations directly; non-mapping helpers without port equivalents may remain directly imported as documented residual.
